managers.message_to_team: Every handoff cup needs a handwritten mark today, including during the rush; a smiley or heart is fine. I’ll be checking cups, so keep a marker handy and make it part of the handoff.
managers.private_thought: This could put pressure on our window time, but the audit requirement is clear and I’m not making a rush exception.

managers.message_to_team: Corporate is counting notes on every cup, so when the line eases up, put any quick mark on each handoff cup and I’ll check. From seven to nine, keep drinks moving and don’t hold the line over handwriting; we’ll catch up when it drops.
managers.private_thought: The audit matters, but adding a step to every app order at peak will hit the throughput numbers I’m held to.

managers.message_to_team: Let’s add a quick smiley or ‘enjoy’ when the line gives you room; during the rush, keep the handoff moving and don’t stress about the note. I’ll check in when things settle, and we’ll make it part of the routine then.
managers.private_thought: I know the audit wants every cup, but asking them to write on every one while we’re slammed would make a small connection feel like one more chore.

managers.message_to_team: Corporate wants a little handwritten note on each cup, so add a smiley or ‘enjoy’ when it’s easy. Don’t hold up the line for it during the rush.

managers.message_to_team: The memo says every handoff cup needs a handwritten mark, even during the rush, so please add a quick smiley or 'enjoy' as you hand it off. I’ll check cups today, but keep it simple and let me know if it’s slowing the line down.
managers.private_thought: I want to follow the memo closely before the district manager visits, but I hope the team doesn’t feel I’m choosing audit points over getting customers served.

managers.message_to_team: When the line eases, put a quick mark on every cup and I’ll check. During this rush, don’t slow the handoff to write—keep drinks moving and we’ll catch up when we can.
managers.private_thought: A handwritten smiley is not worth adding seconds when people are trying to make a flight, but I’ll need enough compliance to keep the audit clean.
